notes: ITEW15 smart phones: Annexure I gives Au 0.00157%, while the published worked example uses 0.0016% (the same figure rounded). The notice value is used.

Gold phase-in: the notice gives 20% (2023-24), 30% (2024-25), 45% (2025-26), 60% (2026-27), 80% (2027-28), 100% (2028-29), then 100% onwards. A secondary source listed 45% twice and 100% only from 2029-30. The notice is used.
Average life: 85 EEE codes use CPCB's draft list of 21 March 2023 (no final list was found on cpcb.nic.in, cpcb.gov.in or eprewaste.cpcb.gov.in). The other 21 use the 2016 CPCB guidelines.
No recycling target applies to CEEW14 (solar PV) under Schedule III note (3) and Schedule IV note (2).
